news.why: Inkling 2 Small is hype-prone and contested: the company's score of 31 and 'open weights next week' versus Artificial Analysis calling it slow and verbose ($1.18 per task), the lab's own table showing rivals ahead, and a hallucination drop that comes partly from answering less. A claims table fits. Leads the issue as the strongest, most discussed story (HN 281 pts).

research.why: A single preprint (LoCo) with a clear what/how/why/uncertain arc: the stop-when-you-have-enough recipe, about 42-45% shorter math answers at similar accuracy, and limits (one 7B model, math-only training, no limitations section, possible overlap with STACK). Explainer is used once, here, and was last used 10-28.

invention.why: Linum P-JiT's $21K claim only makes sense next to alternatives: PixArt-alpha (about $26K, 2023), MicroDiT ($1,890, 2024) and Linum's own v2. A table lets the honest caveat show (compute-only cost, no standard benchmarks, undisclosed data, cannot render text).
